meta.description: GymTracker - Free fitness and workout tracking app. Track exercises, workouts, and personal bests. Start your fitness journey today!
meta.workouts_description: Create and track your custom workout routines. Monitor progress, set personal records, and achieve your fitness goals.
meta.exercises_description: Browse our comprehensive exercise library. Track your personal bests and build custom workout programs.
meta.profile_description: View your fitness progress, track body weight changes, and monitor your personal best records over time.

descriptions.login: Sign in to GymTracker to access your workouts and track your fitness progress.
descriptions.signup: Create your free GymTracker account and start tracking your fitness journey today.
descriptions.forgot_password: Reset your GymTracker password to regain access to your workout tracking account.
descriptions.reset_password: Set a new password for your GymTracker account. Enter your new password to regain access.
descriptions.workouts_current: Track your current workout in progress. Record sets, reps, and weights for each exercise.
descriptions.workouts_history: View your complete workout history. Review past workouts and track your fitness progress over time.
descriptions.workouts_create: Create a new custom workout routine. Add exercises, set reps, and build your perfect training program.
descriptions.profile: View your fitness profile. Track body weight changes, review personal bests, and monitor your progress.
descriptions.exercises: Browse our comprehensive exercise library. Add new exercises and build your custom workout programs.
